title: Privacy Policy
html:
1. Introduction

Welcome to Holy Bible Words. We value your privacy and want to provide transparency about how we handle data on our website. This Privacy Policy explains our use of cookies and our participation in the Google AdSense program.

2. Use of Cookies

We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience on our website. Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help us analyze user behavior and improve our website. We do not use cookies to collect personal information.

3. Google AdSense

Our website displays advertisements provided by Google AdSense. Google AdSense uses cookies to deliver personalized ads based on your interests and online behavior. These cookies may track your browsing activities to provide relevant ads. For more information, please visit the [Google Privacy & Terms] https://policies.google.com/technologies/ads page.

4. Managing Cookies

You can manage your cookie preferences through your web browser settings. Most browsers allow you to block or delete cookies. Keep in mind that disabling cookies may affect your experience on our website.

5. Data Collection and Usage

We do not collect or store any personal information, such as names or contact details when you visit our website. We solely collect non-personal data for analytical purposes, as described in section 2.

6. Changes to this Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in our practices or for legal and regulatory reasons. The effective date of the policy will be stated at the top of this page. By continuing to use our website after any changes, you accept the updated policy.

Reading data stored on your device

Bookmarks, highlights, notes, reading history, reading-plan progress and display settings are saved in your browser’s local storage (or in the app on your phone). They stay on your device and are never sent to us.

7. Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns about our Privacy Policy or the use of cookies on our website, please contact us at admin@holybiblewords.com.

Last updated: February 17, 2025
